description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: port and maritime datasets (perimetre pprn) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 44 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Périmètre du PPRN inondation par débordement direct du fleuve Charente; Périmètre de PPRN inondation par débordement du fleuve Charente de la ; Périmètre du PPRN risque de la commune de Mornac-sur-Seudre - Charente; Périmètre de PPRN inondation par débordement du fleuve Charente sur la. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
